skill.description: Use when building or reviewing AI-OS, Hermes, dashboard, desktop, phone/PWA, chat, sheet, drawer, gesture, motion, or streaming-state interfaces. Apply fluid, responsive, interruptible behavior with accessibility and deterministic verification.

memory.responsibility: Retain user intent stream plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform interruptible state model into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through responsive surfaces while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Select the smallest compatible skill and tool set while preserving approval and verification boundaries.

stages: Model idle loading streaming and failure states
Map desktop phone and PWA surfaces
Design gestures sheets drawers and chat

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
